ranking_note: Only 8 Norwegian institutions appear in the QS World University Rankings 2027, so the ranked list has 8 entries.

universities.name: University of Oslo

profile.ug_entry: Per the national GSU list as shown on UiA’s Bangladesh page: HSC plus 1 year of university education. Bachelor’s places are limited; UiA notes residence permits for Bangladeshi bachelor’s applicants are rarely granted.
profile.pg_entry: HSC plus 4 years of university education (180 ECTS equivalent), with programme-specific courses. Minimum grade is set by each university (UiA: C or better on the Norwegian scale).
profile.english: Test scores differ by university and programme. Check the university’s English requirements page. A Bangladeshi degree taught in English does not exempt you (UiA).
profile.courses: English-taught programmes are listed on Study in Norway and in the university’s programme catalogue.
profile.fees: Tuition for non-EU/EEA students since 2023/24, charged per programme. See UiO’s tuition page for the current rate.
profile.scholarship: UiO states it does not offer scholarships that cover tuition fees.

universities.profile_source: Counselling notes from official university and UDI pages, checked 4 November 2026. QS World University Rankings 2027. Confirm fees and scholarships on the official programme page.

universities.name: University of Agder (UiA)

profile.ug_entry: HSC plus 1 year of university education. UiA notes residence permits for Bangladeshi bachelor’s applicants are rarely granted.
profile.pg_entry: HSC plus 4 years of university education (180 ECTS equivalent). GPA of C or better on the Norwegian scale. Final bachelor’s diploma required.
profile.english: UG: IELTS 5.0, TOEFL iBT 60 (3.5 on the scale used after 21 Jan 2026). PG: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80 (4.0 on the new scale), PTE 62. Bangladeshi degrees taught in English do not exempt you.
profile.courses: English-taught programmes are listed on Study in Norway and in the university’s programme catalogue.
profile.fees: Non-EU/EEA students pay tuition; see UiA’s tuition fee page for current rates.
profile.scholarship: UiA states it does not offer any grants or scholarships.
profile.apply: 1 Nov to 1 Dec. Music performance programmes: 1 Nov to 15 Dec. Apply personally; UiA does not work with recruitment agencies.
profile.funds: Admitted students transfer the living-cost amount to a university deposit account, or the offer is withdrawn (UiA).
